newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan stock indices rise to new record highs.
newsitem.headline: Milan stock indices rise to new record highs.

text.p: The Milan bourse's Mibtel index jumped to a new record high in early trading Wednesday of 13,873 while the blue chip Mib30 powered ahead to 21,143.
The Mibtel closed on Tuesday at 13,744 while the Mib30 finished at 20,979.
Investors are piling into Italian stock and bond markets as expectations increase that Italy will qualify for the first round of membership of a European monetary union.
